pages.text: An $(item)Experience Obelisk$() is the party's well of experience. Anyone can pour levels in and draw them out, so the group can feed whoever needs levels to bind spells or enchant.$(br2)It stores the experience itself, not levels: ten levels poured in at level 40 are worth far more than ten at level 5.

$(l)Making one$()$(li)Cognitive Flux: lapis, an amethyst shard and paper (makes 4).$(li)Smelt it into Amalgam.$(li)Amalgam with copper: Alloy. Amalgam with an emerald: Crystal.$(li)Alloy, Crystal and redstone: an Astute Assembly.$(li)Then the obelisk.$(br2)Flux turns up in ruined portals and Assemblies in desert pyramids.
